name: gestures
title: Gestures
description: The JavaScript half of the mangacn grammar: punch() and withImpact() play the G4 impact on click or keyboard validation (data-impact for ~250 ms), <ImpactLines> draws the short speed lines outside the element, <FocusFlash> draws an optional halo of concentration lines around a window as it opens (G5, never full screen). Everything is skipped with prefers-reduced-motion.
docs: Import from "@/lib/manga/gestures". Installed automatically by the components that use it.

meta.tagline: Impact and flash primitives shared by every component.
meta.usage:
import { ImpactLines, withImpact } from "@/lib/manga/gestures"

<button className="relative data-[impact]:animate-hit" onClick={withImpact(onSave)}>
  Save
  <ImpactLines />
</button>

props.name: punch(el)
props.description: Plays the three-frame impact on an element.

props.name: withImpact(handler)
props.description: Wraps a click handler so it also plays the impact.

props.name: <ImpactLines offset>
props.description: Speed lines on both sides; "far" for bursts.

props.name: <ImpactLines press>
props.description: Also show the lines while the element is pressed. false for a counter that is not a control.

props.name: <FocusFlash />
props.description: Optional halo of concentration lines around a window as it opens.

props.name: <FocusFlash className>
props.description: Extra classes on the halo, for example to change its offset or colour.

props.name: <BubbleTail variant>
props.description: The tail of a bubble: a pointed speech tail, or two round thought dots.

props.name: <BubbleTail weight>
props.description: The line weight in px, matching the bubble's outline.
